_nota: Todas as falas, por chave. E o unico lugar com texto de dialogo: uma traducao futura troca so este arquivo.
vendedor.apresentacao.1: Oh! A customer! Nobody comes down here on purpose.
vendedor.apresentacao.2: Welcome to the only shop below the city. Weapons, trinkets, the odd snack.
vendedor.apresentacao.3: Prices are fair. Mostly. Have a look.
vendedor.primeira_vitoria.1: Wait. You came back... from the bottom?
vendedor.primeira_vitoria.2: Then the old king is gone. Shopping is on me. Well, the browsing is.
vendedor.vitoria.a.1: The champion returns! My best customer.
vendedor.vitoria.a.2: I told everyone I sold you that blade. Don't make me a liar.
vendedor.vitoria.b.1: Another crown in the bag? You make this look easy.
vendedor.morte_rapida.a.1: Back already? I barely finished my nap.
vendedor.morte_rapida.a.2: Maybe buy something sharper this time.
vendedor.morte_rapida.b.1: Did you... go in at all?
vendedor.morte_rapida.b.2: Don't worry. Your secret is safe with me and every rat down there.
vendedor.morte_longa.1: That was a long one. I could hear the fighting from here.
vendedor.morte_longa.2: You were close. Go on, gear up.
vendedor.morte.a.1: Rough night? Happens to the best of us. Mostly to the rest of us.
vendedor.morte.b.1: Nine lives, they say. Spend them wisely.
vendedor.sem_moedas.2: I can't give credit. Window shopping is still free.
vendedor.veterano.1: Ten runs! You're practically furniture down here.
vendedor.veterano.2: I saved the good stock for you. Don't tell the others.
vendedor.gato.muffin.1: Muffin. Try not to swing that sword at my shelves.
vendedor.gato.azrael.1: Your Majesty! Mind the staff, it glows on my receipts.
vendedor.gato.finn.1: Finn! Good aim, good taste. Arrows are on the left.
vendedor.generica.a.1: Fresh stock, straight from the dark. Take a look.
vendedor.generica.b.2: Fine, fine. What do you need?
vendedor.generica.c.1: Every blade here has a story. Some of them even true.
vendedor.generica.d.1: Did you hear something down the corridor?
